"ZOOM! (but wide)"


The Wide Straight Conveyor is a structure that can be bought from The Oak Depot. It is a widened straight section of conveyor belt with small walls.

Details

The Wide Straight Conveyor is functionally identical to the standard Straight Conveyor. The only difference is that the Wide Straight Conveyor is 8 studs wide instead of 6 studs wide. When placed, the Wide Straight Conveyor is a 8×2×8 object. It can be resized to be as short as 6 studs in length, or as long as 12 studs in length.
